Name: Glazing
Description: A shopfront or a stairwell window. Hard and flat like tile, and the worst barrier in the city: glass passes seventy per cent of the low end, which is why you hear a bus through a window and not through the brick beside it. Built as two 6 mm panes with the depth of the box between them (LeafMetres): a pane is light, and goes thin at its coincidence near 2 kHz.
